title: The action of an integer multiplicity 1-triple carried by finitely many rays is a sum of ray integrals with integer densities (parent step 4)
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, let R = (M, θ, ξ) be a 1-dimensional integer multiplicity triple in ℝ^P (IMRep univ 1), and let F be a finite set of unit vectors with H¹(M ∖ ⋃_{e∈F} ray(e)) = 0, where H¹ = μHE[1] and ray(e) := {te : t > 0}. Then there are functions g_e : ℝ → ℝ (one for each e ∈ ℝ^P) such that for every e ∈ F, g_e is locally integrable on (0, ∞) and g_e(t) ∈ ℤ for almost every t > 0, and for every test 1-form ω ∈ 𝒟¹(ℝ^P): R.action(ω) = ∫_M θ(x)·ξ(x)(ω(x)) dH¹(x) = Σ_{e∈F} ∫_{(0,∞)} g_e(t)·ω(te)(e) dt.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 1) (F : Finset (Euclid P)), (∀ e ∈ F, ‖e‖ = 1) → (μHE[1] : Measure (Euclid P)) (R.carrier ∩ (⋃ e ∈ F, (fun t : ℝ => t • e) '' Ioi 0)ᶜ) = 0 → ∃ g : Euclid P → ℝ → ℝ, (∀ e ∈ F, LocallyIntegrableOn (g e) (Ioi 0)) ∧ (∀ e ∈ F, ∀ᵐ t ∂(volume.restrict (Ioi (0 : ℝ))), ∃ k : ℤ, g e t = k) ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 1, R.action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) 1) = ∑ e ∈ F, ∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), g e t * (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) 1) (t • e) (fun _ => e)
